meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to a local model and save API costs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to run your AI assistant locally and cut API costs.

howto.what: 把指定的 agent group 从 Anthropic API 切到本地 Ollama 模型:改写 container.json 的环境变量与共享 settings.json 里的 model,再重启服务。Ollama 原生支持 Anthropic 接口,不用改 provider 代码。
howto.when: 当你想让 agent 本地运行、减少 API 花费,或试验开放权重模型时触发。前提是 Ollama 已安装并运行、模型已拉取,且 agent group 已存在。

say.note: 移除 env 与 model 键后重启,不用重建

howto.what_en: Switches a chosen agent group from the Anthropic API to a local Ollama model: edits container.json env vars and the shared settings.json model, then restarts the service. No provider code changes are needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to run an agent locally, cut API costs, or try open-weight models. Requires Ollama installed and running, a model pulled, and an existing agent group.
